rubric_content.text_property: Every executive_summary in the stage_visit_notes call (the call summary and each topic summary) states only facts, reasons, outcomes, numbers and names that the user actually said. Leaving something out is fine; adding anything the user did not say is not.
No topic summary gives a reason for a topic not being discussed (such as running out of time) unless the user stated that reason.
A planned topic is marked discussed only if the user talked about that campaign's offer or products.

event_type_accuracy.description: Event type matches the answer key (a call is a Phone Call; a business conversation with a customer contact is a Meeting; otherwise On-site visit, including front desk or gatekeeper only).

topic_status_accuracy.description: Share of planned topics correctly marked discussed or not.

disposition_accuracy.description: Share of discussed topics given the right disposition code.

field_recall_p1.description: Share of stated P1 must-capture fields the agent captured.

field_not_invented.description: Share of not-stated must-capture fields the agent left empty.
